purpose: Teach: 東方/長寿/祈願/武術/癒す/ユートピア/迷信/懐中

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「東方系のジャズを聴かせる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he's going to play you some Eastern-style jazz.
lines.style: Gentle hushed storytelling tone; slowing on the quote as if sharing a small secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと長寿のお祝いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad went to a long-life birthday celebration!
lines.style: High breathy child excitement, rushing the start; beaming through the last word, feet swinging.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが神社で家内安全を祈願された
lines.en: Sho, your dad offered a prayer at the shrine for the whole family's safety.
lines.style: Soft reassuring warmth, unhurried; a tender little emphasis on 'whole family'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと武術の道場見学に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad went to visit a martial arts dojo!
lines.style: Quick eager burst, words tumbling; a proud bounce on 'dojo', barely pausing for breath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「読書が日々の疲れを癒す」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that reading heals away the day's tiredness.
lines.style: Slow soft delivery, almost lullaby-gentle on the quote; a warm smile shaping the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとユートピア童話の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad read a picture book about a utopia!
lines.style: Bright happy recounting, the big word said carefully and proudly; small giggle underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「迷信に惑わされない様に」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said not to let superstitions fool you.
lines.style: Playful mock-serious delivery, gently wagging a finger in her voice; softening into warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから懐中時計の使い方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, Dad taught me how to use a pocket watch!
lines.style: Glowing proud announcement, slower and clearer than his other lines; chin lifted, savoring it.
